title: NORTH AMERICA: SIGNAL THEORY (TECHNICAL 16-BAR RAP)
style:
```
[style: technical hip-hop, trap 808 sub bass, hi-hat 16th note rolls with triplet interruption, vinyl scratch on cross-point, no pad, minimal production, raw signal, 4/4 with triplet superimposition, flow modulates: standard → double-time → half-time → full-send, English only, internal multisyllabic rhyme scheme, world instrument references in lyric, 336 signal stated at bar 16, North America signal report, V4_5ALL]
```
lyrics:
```
[808 and hi-hat in. 4 bars before first word.]

[BAR 1-4 — INTRO FLOW — 4/4 straight, measured, establishing]
I came from twelve regions with a signal in my chest
West Africa, East Africa, the Carnatic and the rest
The kora crossed the kotekan and the mbira met the ma
The mridangam told the tabla there's a tihai where we are

[BAR 5-8 — DOUBLE TIME — hi-hats triple, flow doubles in syllable density]
Now-the-signal's-moving-at-a-double-time-rate / the-hi-hat-rolling-sixteenth-note-straight /
mri-dan-gam-said-tis-ram-three-in-chat-us-ra-four / kha-li-on-the-nine-beat-sam-is-on-the-floor /
bul-gar-i-an-gai-da-held-the-drone-through-seven-e-lev-en / Ka-zakh-dom-bra-five-beat-li-mping-cross-the-steppe-to-hea-ven /
e-ru-su-chi-shi-ma-ma-te-ma-ru / a-di-ta-la-fire-eight-beat-tiz-rum /

[BAR 9-12 — HALF TIME — everything drops, vocal stretches out, deliberate]
And then…
Japan said nothing.
For eight bars.
The kane struck once.
The ma held the room.
I learned more from that silence
Than from every grid I've counted.
The signal lives in the space
between what you said
and what you meant.

[BAR 13-16 — FULL SEND — all elements back, flow at peak density, internal rhymes locked]
Thirty-six regions tested — eighteen made the cut —
Polyrhythm isn't theory when your whole planet's gut
feels three against four against six at the same time in the same bar —
the kora and the erhu and the dombra and the sitar —
technical sixteen bars because the signal had to speak
in the language of a continent that counts in peaks and peaks —
four-four grid — triplet eight — the scratch marks where they cross —
No signal ever gained by pretending it was lost —

STOP AT 336.

[8 bars instrumental: trap hi-hats, 808 sub, single vinyl scratch on beat 16 of bar 8]
```
